questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The d-block element which is a liquid at room temperature, having high specific heat, less reactivity than hydrogen and its chloride \(MX_2\) is volatile on heating is:
questions.explanation:
The clues point to mercury (Hg):

Hg is a d-block element.
It is liquid at room temperature.
It has relatively high specific heat.
It is less reactive than hydrogen.
Mercury forms volatile mercurous chloride, \(\mathrm{Hg_2Cl_2}\), which can sublime/decompose on heating.

questions.question: Manganese steel is used for making railway tracks because:
questions.option_a: It is hard with high percentage of Mn
questions.option_b: It is soft with high percentage of Mn
questions.option_c: It is hard with small concentration of manganese with impurities
questions.option_d: It is soft with small concentration of manganese with impurities
questions.explanation:
Explanation

Manganese steel (Hadfield steel) contains a high percentage of manganese, typically around 12–14% Mn.

It is used for railway tracks because it is:

     Very hard
     Tough
     Highly resistant to wear and abrasion
     Under impact, it becomes even harder (work hardening).

questions.explanation:
Adding a high proportion of manganese to steel produces manganese steel (Hadfield steel), which is known for its high hardness, toughness, and wear resistance.
